// diagnostic

E-WEB-TARGET-BROWSER

`bad` is pinned to Wasm but uses the `Browser` effect

What

`bad` is pinned to Wasm but uses the `Browser` effect

Why

The web backend keeps DOM/view code in JS and compute in WASM; a Wasm-pinned function cannot call browser APIs directly. A `jet build --target=web` run reports this web-target diagnostic.

Fix

Remove the `#Target(Wasm)` pin, move browser work into a `#Target(JS)` function, or drop the browser API calls

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E-WEB-TARGET-BROWSER: tests/ui/web_target_browser.stderr.
